parent_note: Delta sibling per the established snapshot-freeze convention. At this delta's creation, 42/45 files frozen by the parent manifest were re-verified byte-identical; the only drift is protocol/WELP.md (execution-state lifecycle blocks), docs/reproduction.md (publication-routing step), and summaries/welp_compatibility_policy.json (snapshot-lineage repair), each changed only by this delta's documented rule blocks and re-frozen here at final bytes.
basis: 2026-09-21 Agent Workflow Policy Corrections pass plus the independent 2026-09-22 Agent Workflow Policy Diff Audit (tmp/agent-workflow-policy-diff-audit/REPORT.md): complete the automatic-closeout lifecycle policy with its provenance record. The uncommitted protocol/WELP.md execution-state lifecycle (success branch -> automatic terminal closeout; failure/incomplete branch -> STOP, report, human review) had superseded the parent delta's frozen two-stage lifecycle content without a freeze record; this delta records that supersession and repairs the compatibility-policy snapshot lineage, which had also omitted the already-committed 2026-09-21 delta. No contract, schema, harness, scorer, fixture, or validator changes; validator enforcement of lifecycle terminal states remains deferred to the v1.0 governance freeze.

changes.LIFECYCLE-AUTO-CLOSEOUT: Supersedes the parent delta's LIFECYCLE-TWO-STAGE rule in protocol/WELP.md. The prior lifecycle requirement of science -> human scientific acceptance -> closeout is replaced by the campaign execution-state lifecycle: clean COMPLETE_PASS/PASS execution with green required validators, internally consistent evidence, and no unresolved methodology/runtime/artifact/scope/external-service blocker continues automatically through terminal closeout in one pass (no human scientific-acceptance gate; routine closeout actions executed, not re-gated, under the bounded standing authorization); failure/incomplete execution (BLOCKED, FAIL, FAILED_EXECUTION, COMPLETE_WITH_GAPS, validator failure, evidence inconsistency, unresolved issues, authentication/service/publication/deployment failure, archive/hash mismatch, unexpected scope expansion) STOPs: preserve evidence, finish REPORT.md, state the exact blocker, smallest next action, and exact report path, and wait for human review. Execution state stays distinct from model classification; a negative or guarded evidence-backed verdict is still a successfully completed campaign. docs/publication.md steps 7 and 11 state the same standing-automatic-closeout-or-explicit-human-authorization gate (related change; publication.md sits outside the parent freeze scope, so it is documented here rather than hash-pinned).
changes.REPRO-PUBLICATION-ROUTING: docs/reproduction.md operator checklist step 12 corrected to the same pattern: heading unconditioned from 'separate human authorization required'; pushes and website deployment run under the campaign's standing automatic-closeout authorization (success branch of the WELP execution-state lifecycle) or explicit human authorization; the out-of-scope initial-repository push clarified as 'the initial public push (human)'.
changes.COMPAT-LINEAGE: summaries/welp_compatibility_policy.json snapshot_lineage repaired to truthful chronological order: the committed 2026-09-21 localmaxxing-closeout-rule delta entry added, this delta appended as current DRAFT, the 2026-09-19 methodology revision marked as the methodology in force (superseded as latest snapshot by lifecycle deltas). No historical snapshot identifier rewritten; no compatibility semantics changed.

validation_at_freeze.parent_freeze_integrity: 42/45 parent-frozen files byte-identical; protocol/WELP.md, docs/reproduction.md, and summaries/welp_compatibility_policy.json differ only by this delta's documented rule blocks and are re-frozen at final bytes
validation_at_freeze.methodology_artifacts_unchanged: all contracts, schemas, harness, scorers, fixtures, and validators byte-identical to the parent freeze

historical_compatibility: Historical campaigns remain valid under their frozen snapshots and contracts; never relabeled. Frozen historical evidence states (e.g. MEASURED_NOT_SUBMITTED, PENDING_HUMAN_GATE recorded under the prior two-stage lifecycle) remain valid historical truth under the snapshot at which they were executed; later closeout under this lifecycle drives live dispositions to terminal states without rewriting frozen evidence. Model queue remains PAUSED.
model_testing_resume_gate: This delta changes no measurement methodology, gate, or classification rule. Spark (spark-x2.5-4b) campaign closeout under the new lifecycle is the next task; no Spark evidence, submission, publication, or archival was performed in this delta.

deferred.validator_enforcement_of_terminal_rule: Deferred to the v1.0 governance freeze (carried over from the 2026-09-21 delta): enforcing lifecycle terminal states requires a lifecycle-phase field in the campaign manifest schema plus validator rules and selftest fixtures; the documentation rule is the current durable contract.
